result.topic_en: The page has two layers. One is a faint pencil note in German on the heat equation and on solving a related second-order PDE with exponential trial functions. The other, in ink and written upside down, is a set of calculations with partial derivatives, logarithmic derivatives and continued-fraction-like expressions of the form $z \mp a_1 + \frac{r_1^2}{z-a_2}$.
